value.answer: It depends on the lender and on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down). The lowest insured 5-year fixed I found is 4.34%. For uninsured, sources disagree (4.44% or 4.64%), so I can't confirm that one. The big banks are higher: one of them is at 4.54% and Scotiabank is at 4.74%. Fixed rates have been creeping up since early September. I didn't find a Toronto or Ontario figure, so these are national numbers.
